title: Sally's Diary
passage: Below is a page from Sally's diary. April 21st, 2022. Dear Diary, My friends were so mean to me yesterday. I think I need some new ones. First, when I was in class, one of my friends passed me a note. She said it was from a boy. The note said that he has admired me for a long time, and he wants to ask me out. I was so happy because I like him too. Then our teacher saw the note and took it away. When the teacher asked me who gave me the note, I pointed to the boy. He looked at me like I was a stranger and said he had never spoken to me before. I felt so embarrassed and I burst into tears. Then the teacher said I wasn't being honest. He took me to the principal's office, and he called my mom to tell her what happened. This got me in so much trouble. While this was happening, my friends were all laughing at me. They thought all of this was so funny. Diary, sometimes it seems like you are the only one who listens to me. I still have a lot to learn about true friendship, and I am glad that I have you to talk to.
